title: HEARTFELT PRAISE
ISAIAH TWENTY-FIVE
poster: O LORD THOU ART MY GOD
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: golden sunbeams filtering through ancient oak forest canopy
mist rising slowly off a quiet morning meadow
soft light reflecting on a calm winding river
dappled sunlight on mossy stone in a peaceful garden
dew drops resting on blades of grass in soft morning light
gentle river flowing through a sun-drenched valley

scenes.a: If that recurring anxiety is pulling your thoughts away from peace right now, stay here.
O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
I bring this heavy heart before You knowing that Your works remain perfect and unchanging always.
Your hand has guided me through shadows I never thought I would survive until this hour.
Thank You for the mercy that meets me in the silence when my words feel small.
Help me walk forward in the confidence of Your truth, anchored by Your unfailing love alone.
